title: Report after levelling
prompt: Members `level` at 1 and `max_health` at 100, with a working `level_up`. Write `report`, which prints level and then max_health. solve calls level_up, then report.
starter:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func solve():
	pass

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2
hints: report reads the members after the change.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

solution:
var level = 1
var max_health = 100

func solve():
	level_up()
	report()

func level_up():
	level += 1
	max_health *= 2

func report():
	print(level)
	print(max_health)
